_note: Phase 3h assumptions (fictional company, sample records). These are NOT measured and NOT facts about any real firm: they are starting numbers a viewer should replace with their own. The page labels each one as an assumption.
coordinator_cost_note: Assumption: what an hour of an onboarding coordinator's time costs the firm, pay plus taxes and benefits. Replace with your own.
minutes_note: Assumption, not measured: reading the packet, comparing names, chasing, and typing the setup sheet by hand, versus reviewing the AI's drafts and flags.
days_sooner_note: Assumption, not measured: how many days earlier each vacant home's rent-paying start date moves when problems surface on day one instead of one at a time, assuming the rent is collected.

benchmark.grade: industry survey (B): NARPM's 2022 Financial Performance Guide, 2021 data; about $222 revenue per occupied unit a month for its qualifying sample (the full study had 153 participating companies); adjusted average profit margin about 11% after normalizing owner pay. Historical context from study participants, not a Sarasota figure or an all-US average
